definitions.explanation: The country to which the speaker or subject belongs. Used in formal and written contexts when discussing national policies, international comparisons, or patriotic matters.

examples.japanese: {自国|じこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: To value one's own country's culture.

examples.japanese: {自国|じこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。
examples.english: Tariffs were raised to protect domestic industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んで→住む：00673_sumu⟧みて⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧、{自国|じこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes it's only after living abroad that you realize the good things about your own country.

notes:
A compound of {自|じ} (self) and {国|こく} (country). Formal in register and common in news, political discourse, and academic writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自国|じこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧ (one's country's interests)
- {自国|じこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (one's own culture)
- {自国|じこく}{民|みん} (citizens of one's own country)
- {自国|じこく}⟦{通貨|つうか}→通貨：03508_tsuuka⟧ (domestic currency)

Note the homophone ⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧ (time, hour), which is a completely different word. In casual speech, ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧ is more natural than {自国|じこく}.
